I have a clear picture of the issue now. Let me summarize my findings:

**The feature request** asks that the Extra Networks UI (the popup with model cards for checkpoints/LoRAs/textual inversions/hypernetworks) sort items by date by default, so a newly downloaded model appears at the top when the interface opens.

**Investigation results:**
- `modules/ui_extra_networks.py` (line 384) creates the sort dropdown with `value='Default Sort'` — this is where the default sort order is defined.
- `javascript/extraNetworks.js` implements `applySort`, but it only triggers on user interaction with the dropdown (`change`/`blur`/`click`). `applyExtraNetworkFilter` (called when the cards are loaded via the `page_elem.change` handler in `ui_extra_networks.py`) only applies the search filter — so even if the dropdown default changed, sorting wouldn't be applied on open without JS changes.
- `modules/shared_options.py` has the "Extra Networks" settings section (`ui_extra_networks_tab_reorder` etc.) where a configurable default-sort setting would be added, following the standard webui pattern.
